GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG370.5 (10 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN-416)
10 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Permission to Repatriate Chinese Laborers and Students on the S.S. Meiyu Maru.
1. reference is made to C. L. O. Nos 878(5.1) and 972(5.1) same subject dated 5 and 8 December 1945 respectively
2. Permission is granted to place aboard Japanese vessel S. S. Meiyu Maru the Chinese repatriates mentioned in the above cited references. These repatriates will embark for Shanghai at Kagoshima on 12 December 1945
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. Allen,
Colonel, A. G. D.
Asst. Adjutant General.
